subject: general
question: With which of the following sports/games is Rani Rampal associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rani Rampal** is a **Haryana-based Indian field hockey player**.
 
• She is now the** Indian Women's Hockey Team's Captain**.
 
• Rani Rampal, the captain of the Indian women's hockey team, has been named **World Games Athlete of the Year 2019**, making her the first hockey player to win the prestigious award.
 
• The Indian government awarded her the **Padma Shri in 2020**.
 
• Rani won the Champion's Challenge Tournament in Kazan, Russia in June 2009, scoring four goals in the finals to lead India to victory.
 
• She was the youngest player in the national team that competed in the 2010 World Cup at the age of 15. 
 
• **Neha Goyal (24, Midfielder), Nikki Pradhan (27, Defender), Nisha Warsi (26, Midfielder), and Lalremsiami (21, Forward),** are also **some famous female hockey players of India.**
